examples.text: At this memorable Diet of Speyer (1529), a compact Roman Catholic majority faced a weak Lutheran minority. […] It was this ordinance which called forth the celebrated Protest, from which comes the name Protestant. The Protest was read in the Diet on the day (April 19th, 1529) when all concessions to the Lutherans had been refused.
